svg.font-family: Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', 'Malgun Gothic', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: openDMT3's server and its clients. On the player's Windows PC the launcher (opendmt3/client) only reads the client data and starts the game, the player's own PC client, with openDMT3's card reader library and in-game layer in its process (native/cardreader). A server is one process (opendmt3/server, in Docker or with Python): the site and its API on port 4730 (web/), the game server on port 4725, their services and one SQLite file (services/, db/), and the song list read once from the client data. The launcher signs in over the HTTP API and asks for the player's card at each PLAY; the game logs in by card and sends its results over the game's own protocol. Browsers on phones and PCs use the site, programs the API with a token, and other players' PCs the same two links. The releases hold the installer and its signed updates, which a server can hand out. opendmt3/core is shared by both parts, packaging/ builds them and tests/ checks them.
